intraday_features.name: intraday_momentum
intraday_features.description: Sum of ResidReturn over a configurable time window. Grid search: start_time × end_time.

intraday_features.name: intraday_reversal
intraday_features.description: Late minus early intraday ResidReturn. Grid search: split point between early/late windows.

intraday_features.name: resid_vol
intraday_features.description: Intraday volatility (std) of ResidReturn. Grid search: start_time × end_time.

intraday_features.name: late_day_trend
intraday_features.description: Late-day momentum minus its K-day rolling mean. Grid search: lookback_days × start_time.

intraday_features.name: intraday_skewness
intraday_features.description: Skewness of intraday ResidReturn. Grid search: start_time × end_time.

intraday_features.name: volume_weighted_pressure
intraday_features.description: Volume-weighted intraday ResidReturn. Grid search: start_time × end_time.

intraday_features.name: early_late_volume_mix
intraday_features.description: Late vs early volume distribution. Grid search: split_time.

intraday_features.name: return_volume_corr
intraday_features.description: Correlation between ResidReturn and Volume. Grid search: time window.

intraday_features.name: gap_continuation
intraday_features.description: Opening gap vs intraday continuation. Grid search: close_time × open_time.

intraday_features.name: lag1_autocorr
intraday_features.description: Lag-1 autocorrelation of ResidReturn. Grid search: start_time × end_time.

intraday_features.name: amihud_illiquidity
intraday_features.description: Mean(|ResidReturn| / Volume). Amihud illiquidity ratio. Grid search: time window.

intraday_features.name: intraday_range
intraday_features.description: Max - min of CumReturnResid within time window. Intraday volatility proxy.

intraday_features.name: roll_measure
intraday_features.description: 2*sqrt(-cov(r_t,r_{t-1})). Roll illiquidity measure. Grid search: time window.

intraday_features.name: intraday_kurtosis
intraday_features.description: Excess kurtosis of intraday ResidReturn. Grid search: start_time × end_time.

intraday_features.name: intraday_vwap_deviation
intraday_features.description: (Close - VWAP) / VWAP. Intraday VWAP deviation. Grid search: time window.

intraday_features.name: intraday_volume_concentration
intraday_features.description: Herfindahl index of intraday volume distribution. Grid search: time window.

daily_features.name: volume_surge_ratio
daily_features.description: CumVol_15:30 * CloseAdj_T-1 / MDV_63_T-1.

daily_features.name: realized_vs_implied_vol_ratio
daily_features.description: (HighAdj - LowAdj) / (CloseAdj * EST_VOL * sqrt(1/252)), uses T-1.

daily_features.name: adjusted_overnight_gap_return
daily_features.description: Open_T-1 / Close_T-2 - 1 (T-1 overnight gap).

daily_features.name: vol_scaled_momentum
daily_features.description: R^(K) / EST_VOL — momentum scaled by implied volatility. Grid search: lookback K.

daily_features.name: mean_reversion_ma
daily_features.description: CloseAdj / SMA(CloseAdj, K) - 1. Classic mean-reversion signal. Grid search: lookback K.

daily_features.name: short_term_reversal
daily_features.description: Close-to-close return over lag days. Classic short-term reversal. Grid search: lag.

daily_features.name: bollinger_band
daily_features.description: (CloseAdj - SMA(K)) / rolling_std(K). Bollinger band z-score. Grid search: lookback K.

daily_features.name: raw_momentum
daily_features.description: Past K-day cumulative return (no vol scaling). Jegadeesh-Titman momentum.

daily_features.name: turnover
daily_features.description: VolumeAdj / MDV_63. Classic turnover/liquidity factor.

daily_features.name: week52_high
daily_features.description: (Close - min_K) / (max_K - min_K). Distance from 52-week range.

daily_features.name: max_daily_return
daily_features.description: Max of past K daily returns. Bali et al. lottery effect.

daily_features.name: high_low_range
daily_features.description: (High - Low) / Close. Daily volatility proxy.

daily_features.name: volatility_ratio
daily_features.description: Short-term vol / long-term vol. Grid search: K_short × K_long.

daily_features.name: volume_trend
daily_features.description: Volume / MA(Volume, K) - 1. Grid search: lookback K.

daily_features.name: open_to_close_return
daily_features.description: (Close - Open) / Open. Intraday open-to-close return.

daily_features.name: down_volume_ratio
daily_features.description: Volume on down days / total volume over K days. Grid search: K.

daily_features.name: close_position_daily_range
daily_features.description: (2*Close - High - Low) / (High - Low). KSFT factor.

daily_features.name: upper_shadow_ratio
daily_features.description: (High - max(O,C)) / (High - Low). Upper shadow ratio.

daily_features.name: up_to_down_volume_ratio
daily_features.description: Volume on up days / volume on down days over K days. Grid search: K.

daily_features.name: volume_autocorrelation
daily_features.description: Lag-1 autocorrelation of daily volume. Grid search: K.

daily_features.name: free_float_adjusted_turnover
daily_features.description: Turnover / (FREE_FLOAT_PERCENTAGE/100).

daily_features.name: body_to_range_ratio
daily_features.description: |Close - Open| / (High - Low). Body-to-range ratio.

daily_features.name: daily_price_volume_corr
daily_features.description: Correlation(Close, Volume) over K days. Alpha #6 style. Grid search: K.

daily_features.name: rsv_short
daily_features.description: (Close - min_Low_K) / (max_High_K - min_Low_K). Stochastic. Grid search: K.

daily_features.name: rsv_long
daily_features.description: (Close - min_Low_K) / (max_High_K - min_Low_K). Stochastic. Grid search: K.
